---
lang: it
format:
  pdf:
    pdf-engine: pdflatex
    papersize: a4
    geometry:
      - portrait
      - margin = 10mm
      - bottom = 25mm
    fontsize: 10pt
    linestretch: 1
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          \usepackage{fancyhdr}
          \usepackage{lastpage}
          \newcount\hours
          \newcount\minutes
          \newcommand{\printtime}{%
            \hours=\time
            \divide\hours by 60
            \minutes=\time
            \multiply\hours by 60
            \advance\minutes by -\hours
            \divide\hours by 60
            \ifnum\hours<10 0\fi\the\hours:%
            \ifnum\minutes<10 0\fi\the\minutes:00%
          }
          \pagestyle{fancy}
          \fancyhf{} % Ripulisce i default
          \renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}
          \renewcommand{\footrulewidth}{0pt}
          \fancyfoot[L]{\texttt{Print date:~\the\day-\ifnum\month<10 0\fi\the\month-\the\year\ \printtime}}
          \fancyfoot[R]{\texttt{Page \thepage\ of \pageref*{LastPage}}}

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

options(width = 150, tibble.width = Inf)
df_list <- readRDS("data/export.rds")

if (length(df_list) == 0) {
  cat("No dataframes found in export.rds file.\n")
} else {
  df_names <- names(df_list)

  cat("\\begin{minipage}{\\linewidth}\n")
  cat("\\begin{verbatim}\n")
  cat("PERSONAL CLINICAL ACTIVITY\n\n")
  cat("Last data update:", format(max(df_list[["0) Complete"]]$Date), "%d-%m-%Y"))
  cat("\\end{verbatim}\n")
  cat("\\end{minipage}\\vspace{1.5em}\n")

  for (i in seq_along(df_list)) {
    df_name <- df_names[i]
    df <- df_list[[i]]
    
    if (df_name != "0) Complete") {
      tbl_txt <- knitr::kable(df, format = "simple", align = "l")
      tbl_rows <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(tbl_txt), "\n"))
      tbl_width <- max(nchar(tbl_rows))
      sep <- paste(rep("-", tbl_width), collapse = "")
      cat("\\begin{minipage}{\\linewidth}\n")
      cat("\\begin{verbatim}\n")
      cat(str_replace(toupper(df_name), "PVT ", ""), "\n")
      cat(sep, "\n")
      cat(tbl_txt, sep = "\n")
      cat(sep, "\n")
      cat("\\end{verbatim}\n")
      cat("\\end{minipage}\n")
      cat("\\vspace{1.5em}\n\n")
    }
  }
}
```
